cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(HexLabX86ExecutionOracle LANGUAGES CXX)
if(NOT MSVC OR NOT CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 4 OR NOT CMAKE_GENERATOR_PLATFORM STREQUAL "Win32")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "The execution oracle must be compiled independently by MSVC for Win32")
endif()
add_executable(hexlab_x86_32_oracle oracle.cpp)
target_compile_features(hexlab_x86_32_oracle PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
target_compile_options(hexlab_x86_32_oracle PRIVATE /W4 /WX)
target_link_options(hexlab_x86_32_oracle PRIVATE /INCREMENTAL:NO)
